Factor exposures: market 0.24 (t 5.7), size -0.06 (t -1.3), growth 0.14 (t 1.4), momentum 0.01 (t 0.3); together they explain 54% of the daily variation (R²).
Of its -0.6% a year over T-bills (arithmetic mean): market +5.1%, growth +3.3%, size -0.3%, momentum +0.3%; the alpha left is -9.0% a year (t = -1.0, within noise).
